versions.content: Upstream requirements: SRS_Rte_00019, SRS_Rte_00033, SRS_Rte_00110 Unless a server call is implemented as a direct or trusted function call, the RTE shall buffer a request on the server side in a first-in-first-out queue as described for queued data elements.

Unless a server call is implemented as a direct or trusted function call, the RTE shall buffer a request on the server side in a first-in-first-out queue as described in chapter 4.3.1.10.2 for queued data elements. Note: The data that shall be buffered is implementation specific but at least RTE should store the IN parameters, the IN/OUT parameters and a client identifier.
